the mmW RF system can be implemented with the beam switching link or multi-beam sector link.
the RF subsystem is developed with 8 I/O ports and the system performance is verified with 1GHz bandwidth and 5Gbps data rate in the coverage area of 30~50m.
the mmW RF subsystems are developed to achieve 1Gbps data rate in 3.5~3.7GHz frequency band with a coverage area of ~50m.

the mmW subsystems for the 5g application.
the RF subsystem design for the 5g applications.
the development of RF subsystems for the 5th generation mobile communication (5G).

the RF subsystem design is feasible to meet the requirements of 5G applications in the mmW bands.
the proposed RF subsystems are suitable for mmW 5G applications, and the system design and performance can be further improved in the future.
the 28GHz RF subsystems for mmW 5G application is feasible.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mmW RF system design and its characteristics are well defined, which is the key to the 5G application.
the system design and implementation are feasible and the RF components have the potential to meet the requirements of the 5G systems.
the mmW RF subsystems are feasible for the 5th generation mobile and wireless communications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mmW RF subsystem is feasible to be integrated into a compact size and low power system for 5G application.
the RF subsystems are capable of providing the high throughput and high capacity for the 5th generation mobile communication systems.
the beam steering and sector coverage are two important features for the 5g applications, and the RF subsystem design is a key enabler for the 5 Gbps data transmission in a large coverage area.
